newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures close sharply lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures close sharply lower.

text.p: Jan 2 - U.S. debt futures closed sharply lower, as concerns about the rate of U.S. economic growth continued to grow. The rise in NAPM and the price component in NAPM sparked a strong sell-off. However, traders noted steady retail buying throughout the session. U.S. Nov construction spending data will be released at 1000 EST/1500 GMT on Friday.
